title: Cocoa prices are easing. So why is chocolate still so expensive?
summary: Despite easing cocoa prices, chocolate remains expensive due to lingering effects of poor weather conditions, tariffs, and Middle East geopolitical tensions that disrupted supply chains. Chocolate manufacturers are focusing on premium products and social media trends to recover lost sales and win back price-conscious consumers.
content: Chocolate firms look to win shoppers back with premium products and social media trends after poor weather conditions, tariffs, and the Iran war hit sales.

zh.title: 可可价格下跌 巧克力为何仍然昂贵?
zh.summary: 尽管可可价格下跌，巧克力仍然昂贵，这是因为恶劣天气条件、关税和中东地缘政治紧张局势导致的持久影响破坏了供应链。巧克力制造商正专注于高端产品和社交媒体趋势，以恢复失去的销售并赢回价格敏感的消费者。

title: Primark's new 'supermarket tactic' to woo customers in online price war
summary: Primark is implementing new pricing and retail tactics to compete with ultra-cheap Chinese e-commerce retailers amid an ongoing cost of living crisis. Analysts indicate these competitive pressures are reducing customer traffic at physical stores.
content: Competition from ultra-cheap Chinese retailers and the cost of living crisis could be putting some people off shopping at the store, analysts say.

zh.title: Primark新"超市战术"在线上价格战中吸引顾客
zh.summary: Primark正在实施新的定价和零售战术，在持续的生活成本危机中与超便宜的中国电商零售商竞争。分析人士表示，这些竞争压力正在减少实体店的客流量。

title: Rental searches for pet friendly properties drop after law change
summary: Rental searches for pet-friendly properties have declined following a law change that clarified pet ownership policies. Agents report that renters are confused about whether landlord permission for pets is automatically guaranteed, leading to decreased interest in pet-friendly rental listings.
content: Agents say some renters wrongly believe permission to have a pet is guaranteed.

zh.title: 法律变化后宠物友好租赁物业的搜索量下降
zh.summary: 在澄清宠物所有权政策的法律变化后，宠物友好租赁物业的搜索量有所下降。房产经纪人报告称，租户对房东是否会自动同意养宠物感到困惑，导致对宠物友好租赁清单的关注度降低。
